run_kernel_bmm_chunk_fwd: run the Triton JIT kernel _bmm_chunk_fwd_kernel to compute chunk-wise batch matrix multiplication on GPU tensors
create_bmm_chunk_fwd: create chunked batch matrix multiplication output from two input tensors with optional causal masking and sequence indexing
test_bmm_chunk_fwd_causal: test _bmm_chunk_fwd with causal=True to zero out upper-triangular chunk blocks
test_bmm_chunk_fwd_seq_idx: test _bmm_chunk_fwd with seq_idx to zero out cross-sequence chunk blocks
summarize_bmm_chunk_fwd: summarize _bmm_chunk_fwd which computes block-wise dot products of chunked sequence tensors for Mamba SSD operations
